officialAndRelevantLeads.observation: Official organizational material describes the conservation foncière sections, including a cadastre section. It is institutional evidence, not a parcel data service and does not establish Souk Ahras local coverage.
Official material references exploitation of cadastral plans and archives by cadastral/land-conservation structures. No public feature schema or API was exposed.
Official viewer advertises national/general layers such as wilaya and commune boundaries and raster cartography; it is not evidenced as a cadastral parcel viewer.
Official agency lead with GIS responsibility, but no anonymous Souk Ahras cadastral parcel endpoint was identified.
